objective: Apply the supplied VisePanda Logo and visual identity consistently to the Early Access homepage and standalone /demo route without changing product behaviour or fixture boundaries.
architectureContracts: Public English prose is revised with humanizer and public Chinese prose with neutral humanizer-zh; named-author imitation requires an explicit operator request.
Bilingual pairs change together while facts, numbers, CTA destinations, route arrows, state labels and fixture boundaries stay unchanged.
MAP_CITIES and LANDMARK_ART must contain exactly the same 50 destination ids.
Landmark glyphs are stroke-only paths on a 32x32 grid and render through currentColor.
The map base is static; autoplay changes the active marker only; the pointer lens is fine-pointer-only.
All city activation routes through the top SVG map control layer for mouse, touch and keyboard consistency.
Open-Meteo is fetched server-side; failure omits the weather row.
lib/copy.ts owns landing, comparison and shell copy; lib/demo owns product Demo fixtures and Demo UI copy.
Top-level Demo surfaces are Today, Ask, Copilot, Tools, Explore and User.
The /demo route reuses ProductDemo and lib/demo; standalone mode must not create a second fixture source.
No Canvas change applies without a visible Diff and confirmation.
Copilot owns long-term memory; Tools is top-level; Explore owns Places only.
No public copy may claim existing OTA, hotel, ticketing or ride-hailing partnerships without evidence.
The implementation report describes current code and must keep static Demo fixtures separate from production-ready capabilities.
The public JotForm CTA and frozen waitlist API contract remain unchanged.
The supplied master Logo keeps its Cream sticker edge and is never recoloured, redrawn or destructively cropped.
Plum, Gold, Butter and Cream are the public brand palette; Gold remains an accent rather than the only carrier of state.

Desktop English and Chinese Hero, capability, competitor and Demo copy rendered without framework or console errors; full-screen Demo interaction remained functional.
1440x900, 375x812 and 430x932 passed in English and Chinese without page overflow or console errors. Headings and body copy remained visible.
Strict TypeScript and the Next.js production build passed.
Desktop and 390x844 mobile passed direct navigation, reload, EN/Chinese switching, Explore navigation and return-to-home checks without page overflow or console errors.

The custom-domain route returned HTTP 200. Desktop and 390x844 mobile passed direct navigation, reload, EN/Chinese switching, Tools/Explore navigation and return-to-home checks without page overflow or console errors.

Homepage and /demo loaded the shared local Logo, the homepage map rendered Gold markers and callout treatment, Shanghai activation updated the selected city, and no browser console errors or warnings were recorded.

earlyaccess.go2china.space and /demo loaded the shared Logo on the custom domain. Shanghai activation updated the selected map city and Gold callout; homepage and Demo had no browser console errors or warnings.
50 cities, 50 glyph keys, no missing or extra ids.
HTTP 200 with an array of 50 location responses; server parsing was updated to match.

verification.command: In-app Browser visual and interaction pass
verification.summary: Desktop Hero, competitor section, full screen, tour Diff, import repair, degradation states, Explore area filtering and 375px mobile navigation passed.
1440x900, 375x812 and 430x932 in English and Chinese passed without console errors or page overflow; mouse/keyboard map controls, autoplay, reduced motion, full-screen exit and all new states passed.

Vercel reported success. earlyaccess.go2china.space rendered 50 markers, 50 accessible controls, 50 symbols, the competitor section and completed Demo. Kashgar mouse/weather, full screen, tour Diff and 430x932 mobile passed with no console errors.
Production returned 200 with the new Hero, capability, comparison, Demo and metadata copy. The previous Hero slogan was absent and the corrected 34-screen count was present.
No user email was transmitted during QA.

operatorActions: Use the brand-identity homepage and standalone Demo for Early Access sharing.
Use docs/interactive-demo-implementation-report.md to plan the formal product implementation.
Confirm the public JotForm URL remains current.
risks: The supplied 4K SVG is intentionally not served directly because it embeds a 13 MB raster; retain the local 512px web derivative unless a larger approved surface requires another export.
The copy pass is live; future copy changes should continue using the configured humanizer skills and bilingual fact audit.
Dense eastern-city clusters depend on the pointer lens for labels.
Open-Meteo remains an external dependency; failure omits weather.
The competitor table is category-level positioning, not a sourced named-provider market study.
Production smoke passed, but long-term product outcome and external-service availability are not measured.
rollback: Revert the brand-identity commit to restore the prior purple visual tokens and text-only marks. Product behaviour, the embedded ProductDemo, waitlist API and JotForm destination are unchanged.

nextAction.description: Use the shared visual system for future Early Access surfaces and retain the master-mark usage rules when adding product pages.
nextAction.expectedObservation: New surfaces preserve the Cream sticker edge, use Plum/Gold/Butter/Cream purposefully and do not introduce a second logo source.
